explanation: The 2026-11-27 HYPOMAP Visium entry (changelog.ts and CHANGELOG.md) now describes the authors' conventions: 23 regional clusters, 143 donor-by-region samples, ranking by the value pooled over all of a region's spots, and Unassigned left unranked. Region names, the absence of a minimum-spot or sparse rule, and pooling every spot to summarise a region follow the HYPOMAP authors (Tadross et al. 2025, Supplementary Table 20 and Methods). The 2026-11-27 Visium entry (changelog.ts and CHANGELOG.md) adds the section images for 12 marker genes, each beside a labelled regional-cluster map.
